definitions.explanation: Multiple trees; used to describe a collection of trees.

examples.japanese: {木々|きぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The trees are swaying in the wind.

examples.japanese: {木々|きぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Light is filtering through the trees.
In spring, flowers begin to bloom on the trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{木々|きぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{育|そだ}って→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The trees in the park have grown big, creating cool shade in summer.

notes:
{木々|きぎ} is the plural form of ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (tree), created through reduplication with rendaku (voicing: き→ぎ).

FORMS:
⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ + ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ → {木々|きぎ} (the second き becomes ぎ due to rendaku)

USAGE:
Used when referring to multiple trees collectively. Common in descriptive, poetic, or literary contexts about nature and scenery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木々|きぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: trees grow thick
- {木々|きぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧: among the trees
- {木々|きぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧: trees change color (autumn)
- {木々|きぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: the greenery of trees

SIMILAR REDUPLICATIONS:
- ⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: people
- ⟦{山々|やまやま}→山々：04809_yamayama⟧: mountains
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: days, daily
